title: Buyback requests
referenceHelp: This is a reference only, not a guaranteed purchase price. We determine the final price after receiving and inspecting your phone. Accept the final offer to proceed to payment, or decline it to have your phone returned to the address below.
acknowledge: I understand that the reference value is not the final price and that the phone must be inspected after arrival.
privacy: Photos are used to assess condition, compare the received phone and investigate shipping damage. Only you and authorized staff can access them. Photos are deleted 180 days after the request is closed. Avoid including faces, identity documents or unrelated personal information.
privacyAgree: I agree to the use and retention of these photos for this buyback request.
name: Full name
originalAddress: If the final offer is declined, we return the phone to this address. Please check it carefully before submitting.
login: Sign in to submit or view your buyback requests
photoHelp: Upload one clear front photo with the screen on and one back photo per phone before shipping. Add sides/corners if there is visible damage. Packaging and sealed-parcel photos are separate, optional shipping evidence, especially recommended for high-value or multiple-phone shipments.
photoEvidence: Photos do not guarantee carrier compensation. Keep your proof of posting and follow the packaging requirements in the shipping instructions.
fileHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP. Up to 3 MB after compression.
identityHelp: Read these in Settings → General → About. No packaging barcode is needed.
submitPhotosHelp: Required photos and the phone's serial number and IMEI are needed before review. Please do not ship until your request is approved.
finalHelp: This final offer is based on the received phones. Accept or decline the offer for all phones in this request. Payment is arranged after acceptance; declining starts a return to your original return address.
offerConfirm: Please confirm your choice. Declining starts the return process.
cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? Do not ship a canceled request.
paymentHelp: Payment will be arranged by our team after you accept the final offer. A payment confirmation will appear here once the transfer has been recorded.
receivedHelp: We have received your shipment. Our team will inspect each phone and publish a final offer here.
search: Search name, email, application or tracking number
adminHelp: Review applications and photos before shipping. Inspect received phones before making a final offer; record payment only after the customer accepts.
pricesHelp: Set a reference price by model and storage. It is shown on the storefront and saved on new applications. Existing references and final offers remain unchanged.
linkHelp: After arrival, register each actual phone in Recycled devices and link the matching serial number, IMEI, model and storage before making the final offer.
paidHelp: Record this only after the actual transfer is completed. This button does not send money.
returnHelp: Return the phones to the original return address shown above. This records the return; it does not purchase a shipping label.

errors.BUYBACK_REQUEST_FAILED: Unable to complete the request. Please try again.
errors.BUYBACK_INVALID_STATE: This request has changed. Refresh and try again.
errors.BUYBACK_INVALID_MODEL: Choose a valid iPhone model and storage.
errors.BUYBACK_PHOTOS_REQUIRED: Each phone needs front and back photos; visible frame damage also needs a sides photo. Review or replace any rejected photos.
errors.BUYBACK_IDENTITY_REQUIRED: Enter a different valid serial number and 15-digit IMEI for each phone.
errors.BUYBACK_INVALID_PHOTO: Choose a valid JPG, PNG or WebP image up to 3 MB.
errors.BUYBACK_TOO_MANY_PHOTOS: The photo limit has been reached. Please contact our team.
errors.BUYBACK_REVIEW_NOTE_REQUIRED: Explain why the customer needs to retake this photo.
errors.BUYBACK_OFFER_CHANGED: The final offer has changed. Refresh and review it before accepting.
errors.BUYBACK_ACCEPT_FIRST: The customer must accept the final offer before payment can be recorded.
errors.BUYBACK_LINK_DEVICES_FIRST: Register and link every received phone before publishing the final offer.
errors.BUYBACK_DEVICE_MISMATCH: The linked device must be an unlinked recycled phone awaiting inspection with the same serial number, IMEI, model and storage.
errors.BUYBACK_INVALID_PRICE_ORDER: Base prices must descend from unmarked to visible wear and stay at or above the minimum price.

catalog.title: Buyback price catalog
catalog.help: Maintain appearance base prices, repair deductions and minimum prices by model and storage. The questionnaire calculates live estimates. Changes apply to new estimates and requests.
catalog.referenceInfo: Reference: Swappie {{country}} · {{date}} · EUR. Adjust these values for your own prices.
catalog.missingHelp: This storage was not captured. Enter your own prices or copy and adjust another storage tier of this model. Copied prices are not presented as captured Swappie prices.
catalog.copyHelp: Adjust the base prices and confirm activation after copying. Storage premiums are not uniform.
catalog.batteryThreshold: Deduct when battery health is below (%)
catalog.unknownBattery: Treat unknown battery health as a battery issue
catalog.formula: With faults: estimate = max(minimum price, appearance base − one-time damage fee − sum of repair deductions). Each fault category is deducted once. Without faults, use the appearance base.

fault.BROKEN: Face ID / front camera / speaker issue

catalog.mapping:
Our questionnaire policies:
Use the worst appearance grade among undamaged parts. Damaged parts incur repair deductions without a second appearance penalty.
Display spots, dead pixels, lines, cracks, chips or heavy scratches count as one screen fault.
Frame or back glass damage counts as one frame repair. Face ID / Touch ID, front camera and earpiece faults count as one functional fault.
Battery thresholds and unknown-health policy are editable. Rear camera repairs are not charged automatically because the questionnaire does not ask about the rear camera.
Phones that cannot stay powered on or connect to a mobile network remain ineligible. Incomplete questionnaires use selected answers and assume remaining items are functional and unmarked.
catalog.bulkHelp: Percentage adjustments scale bases, repair deductions, the damage fee and minimum price. A fixed adjustment changes bases and the minimum price only. Review the preview before applying. Existing request estimates and final offers are preserved.
catalog.onlyMissing: Fill unconfigured prices only; preserve existing prices
catalog.previewCount: Update {{count}} configurations; skip {{skipped}} without a reference or matching eligibility.
catalog.empty: No matching model and storage configurations.
catalog.sourceInfo: Swappie BE · {{date}} · EUR · {{count}} models / {{configs}} storage configurations / {{rows}} combination prices. 64GB and 128GB were not captured.
catalog.patternsHelp:
The formula reproduces all 10,720 captured prices. Every model/storage configuration has its own appearance bases, repair costs and floor. Storage and generation premiums are not uniform.
For iPhone 14 256GB: unmarked €294, minimal wear €270, some wear €248, visible wear €236. Charge the €13.98 damage fee once, then screen €105, battery €23, etc., with a €25 minimum. Screen plus battery issues give €152.02.
SEALED_BOX is excluded from the used-phone questionnaire. fixed_price and limit_price are not treated as appearance base prices. There are no captured 64GB / 128GB prices; set these manually.
